outcome.intro: What goes with winning on each map: the places a side holds in each part of the round, the routes it opens along, first blood, keeping together, pushing out, falling back, objectives and what it fields. Each pattern's win rate with and without it, per map and side, allowed for player strength and the score at the time. Correlation, not proof.
outcome.compute: Work out missing moves (reads those matches' tables)
outcome.computeTitle: Summaries made before the outcome analysis lack each side's moves. Ticked, the run works them out from the matches' tables and keeps them in the browser's cache; without, those matches are left out.
outcome.stats: {matches} matches, {read} read; {missing, plural, =0 {} other {# without moves (tick the box to work them out); }}{small, plural, =0 {} other {# on maps with too few to test; }}{tests} patterns tested, {found} said; {secs} s.
outcome.none: Nothing passed: no pattern here wins (or loses) clearly more often than its side does otherwise, consistently enough. That is an answer too.
outcome.noResult: Run the analysis to see what goes with winning.
outcome.sidesBySpawn: The team names change ends between matches here: sides are told apart by where they start (A and B).
outcome.momentTitle: What the winners held at this moment of the round: each zone coloured by the side's win rate when it was there then, against when it was not.
outcome.legendTitle: Each zone and route: the side's win rate when it held (took) it, less its rate otherwise. Teal: won more (a + in the zone), orange: won less (a -), grey: no difference. Faint: few rounds.

outcome.sidesByPlace: The team names change ends between matches here: sides are told apart by where they start, named by the place there.

outcome.badge.consequenceTitle: With this pattern the side was ahead already {with} of the time, against {without} without it, and allowing for the score takes most of the difference away: it more likely follows from winning than leads to it.
outcome.badge.strengthTitle: Allowing for how often the side's players win elsewhere, and for which team it is, takes most of the difference away: stronger players (or the team that wins anyway) do this, it may not be what wins.
outcome.badge.unstableTitle: The direction changes between periods: the overall difference may rest on a few days.
